name: Time Crack
source: A mystery visual novel about trust and the search for truth, when a high-school student is accused of his parents’ murder. Every choice might bring you closer to the truth... or end in tragedy.
translation: 一部探讨信任与追寻真相的悬疑视觉小说：一名高中生被指控为杀害亲生父母的凶手。你做出的每一个选择，都可能让你离真相更近一步……或是以悲剧收场。
